title: Small Business Electricity Supply: Enrollment Channels, Service Territory and Site Usage Limit
content:
Every Small Business Electricity Supply plan is offered on the same enrollment terms. The figures below are the plan values the enrollment and rescission rules read.

| Term | Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Premise class served | commercial | commercial | commercial | commercial | commercial | commercial |
| States offered | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD |
| Largest 12-month historical usage per site | 300000 kWh | 300000 kWh | 300000 kWh | 300000 kWh | 300000 kWh | 300000 kWh |
| Enrollment channels | phone, web, broker | phone, web, broker | phone, web, broker | phone, web, broker | phone, web, broker | phone, web, broker |
| Rescission window after the utility's enrollment confirmation | 3 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 3 calendar days |

**What each term means**

- *Premise class served* is the class of premise the plan may serve: commercial.
- *States offered* are the states in which the plan is offered: Pennsylvania (PA), Ohio (OH), Illinois (IL), New Jersey (NJ) and Maryland (MD).
- *Largest 12-month historical usage per site* is the largest 12-month historical usage a site may have to be served on a small business plan: 300000 kWh, that is three hundred thousand kWh.
- *Enrollment channels* are the channels through which the plan may be enrolled: by phone, on the web, or through an energy broker.
- *Rescission window* is the number of calendar days after the utility's enrollment confirmation date within which the business may rescind: 3.

**Reading examples (hypothetical sites)**

| Site | Usage over the last 12 months | Against the 300000 kWh limit |
|---|---|---|
| A bakery | 42000 kWh | within the limit |
| A warehouse | exactly 300000 kWh | within the limit (it does not exceed the limit) |
| A cold-storage plant | 300001 kWh | above the limit |
